_comment: Knowledge-engine configuration. Every value is a documented, UNCALIBRATED default (no labelled benchmark large enough to calibrate against exists yet). The whole file is hashed into every run manifest so a result can always be reproduced with the exact configuration that produced it.

mapping._comment_context_gate: course_context_min_similarity is NOT duplicated here: the topic mapping uses peers.course_context_min_similarity (the calibrated value); generic_word_course_share = a word in the topics of >= this share of courses is generic (data-driven)

industry._comment: Industry/ESCO layer. Declared BEFORE the first run over the real postings; not tuned on results. Gap/trend/high-demand/partial-coverage thresholds are NOT here: they are the project's existing values in app.core.config (hashed into the run as existing_settings).

employer_boilerplate._comment: jobs.employer_boilerplate. REPEATED: a sentence (>= min_words words) in >= min_share of one employer's postings, under >= min_titles different titles, when the employer has >= min_employer_postings postings (about-us, values, benefits). STATEMENT (statements true): equal-opportunity, accommodation or follow-us wording in any posting (jobs.EMPLOYER_STATEMENT). Such text describes the employer, not the job, and is not read for skills. Checked on the 2026-10 job-board postings (1,148): a sample of removed sentences of six employers, every removed sentence that held a technology skill and a random sample of statement sentences were employer text or section headings. Declared before the analysis was re-run; not tuned on gap results.

intelligence._comment: Engine 2.0 additive analyses. Thresholds declared before the first run on real data; heuristics, not calibrated.

hierarchy._comment: structural_head_min_courses was set after inspecting the head-frequency distribution of this corpus (module/topics labels in 8-16 courses, real topic heads in <= 3); not tuned on labels

curriculum_scope._comment: Curriculum scope (curriculum_scope.py): the expected programme span is the largest last semester reached by at least min_agreeing_documents other curricula of the analysis (same discipline, semester labels from semester 1). A TARGET that lacks some of those semesters is INCOMPLETE and its MISSING/PARTIAL gaps are marked for review (not actionable); classifications are unchanged.

semantic_ai._comment: Ollama + qwen2.5:7b-instruct (Q4_K_M) verified on the project owner's Mac (M5, 16 GB). The endpoint is the Mac's localhost: runs that call the model must execute on that Mac; elsewhere the probe fails and the deterministic fallback records AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. API keys only via named environment variables.

replay._comment: verified model decisions recorded on the machine that hosts the model; replayed by exact (prompt, schema, model, input_hash, context_hash) when the endpoint is not reachable from the pipeline host

promotion._comment: DECLARED 2026-09-27 BEFORE any V3 output existed. Only MODEL_SUPPORTED decisions (evidence validator v2 passed) can have an effect, and only if the V3 run passes this gate on the frozen development benchmark. Effects never create ESCO mappings; they only decide whether an alias mention's sense is established.

semantic_replay._comment: Recorded, hash-verified model runs the pipeline may replay when no live provider is reachable. A run's decisions are replayed by exact cache key; its promotion gate decides whether any decision may have an effect.

runs.name: qwen-270-v3+replay-misses-1
runs.gate_note: same model, prompt and schema as qwen-270-v3; that run's pre-declared gate (FAILED) governs every decision

peers._comment: Semantic peer benchmarking (peer_stage.py). Similarity only proposes candidates; a relationship needs course context plus equality/ESCO evidence. candidate/related minimum = mapping.min_similarity (0.35, the engine's existing topic-mapping threshold). course_context_min_similarity 0.12 = calibrated by scripts/evaluation/calibrate_peer_context.py (rule: lowest threshold with <= 0.1% false positives on 18,075 title-disjoint course pairs; TPR 0.74 on 31 equal-title pairs; the first peer trial run (context threshold 0.25, uncalibrated) had been inspected before this calibration, which is why the threshold is set by a stated rule on course pairs of known identity rather than by the concept results; artifacts/calibration/peer_course_context.json). same_member_share 0.5 = at least half of the smaller concept's specific topics are equal after normalisation.

industry_v2._comment: industry_intel.py. Trend gate = the project's existing settings (min_periods_for_trend, min_eligible_postings_per_period, min_skill_postings_for_trend). min_pp_change 5 pp and min_relative_change 25% are declared before any multi-period data exists; persistent_min_pct 10% = present in at least one posting in ten in every period. Dimension groups below min_group_postings (= intelligence.occupations.min_postings_per_group) are not ranked. Clusters: co-occurrence in >= 3 postings with lift >= 2 among skills with >= 3 postings (= industry.support.observed_min_postings).

occupations_v2._comment: occupation_resolution.py. A posting's context = its established ESCO skill mentions. min_context_skills 3: fewer skills cannot contradict or confirm a title. min_context_overlap 2: at least two of the posting's skills in the occupation's ESCO essential/optional profile (one shared skill is too weak for a transversal-heavy profile).

semantic_validation._comment: human validation of the 48-case stratified subset (scripts/evaluation/semantic_validation.py); gate v3 was declared before any independent label existed and supersedes v2 only when a package's metrics.json reports INDEPENDENTLY_EVALUATED for this exact gate file. Top-level (outside semantic_ai) so the replay cache key is unchanged.

semantic_promotion_v2.note: supersedes the v1 gate only when an independent evaluation result exists for this exact gate file; until then the v1 result (FAILED) keeps SAFE_MODE
semantic_promotion_v2._comment: kept OUTSIDE semantic_ai on purpose: every semantic_ai key except providers is part of the replay cache key; adding a key there would invalidate the recorded Qwen decisions
